title: Identification of a Novel Class of Anti-Melanogenic Compounds, (Z)-5-(Substituted benzylidene)-3-phenyl-2-thioxothiazolidin-4-one Derivatives, and Their Reactive Oxygen Species Scavenging Activities.
authors: Jeong, Yeongmu; Hong, Sojeong; Jung, Hee Jin; Ullah, Sultan; Hwang, YeJi; Choi, Heejeong; Ko, Jeongin; Lee, Jieun; Chun, Pusoon; Chung, Hae Young; Moon, Hyung Ryong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗黑色素生成化合物对酪氨酸酶的抑制活性，涉及小分子-蛋白互作，但对象为酶而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The rate-determining role of tyrosinase makes it a critical component in the mechanism that is responsible for melanogenesis. Thirteen (Z)-5-(substituted benzylidene)-3-phenyl-2-thioxothiazolidin-4-one ((Z)-BPTT) analogs were designed based on the structural features of two potent tyrosinase inhibitors, viz. (Z)-5-(3-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzylidene)-2-thioxothiazolidin-4-one (5-HMT) and (Z)-2-(2,4-dihydroxybenzylidene)benzo[4,5]imidazo[2,1-b]thiazol-3(2H)-one (compound I). The trisubstituted double bond geometry of the (Z)-BPTT analogs that were generated by Knoevenagel condensation was determined using vicinal (1)H and (13)C coupling constants in (13)C NMR spectra. Four analogs, numbers 1-3 and 6, inhibited mushroom tyrosinase 9 to 29 times more potently than kojic acid did. Kinetic study results indicated that these four analogs inhibited mushroom tyrosinase competitively and this was supported by docking simulation. Also, docking results using human tyrosinase suggested that analogs 2 and 3 might be potent human tyrosinase inhibitors. In vitro studies using B16F10 cells (a melanoma cell line) showed that analogs 1, 2, 3, and 6 inhibited cellular tyrosinase and melanin production more than kojic acid did, without perceptible cytotoxicity. In particular, analog 2, which possesses a catechol group, exerted an extremely potent anti-melanogenic effect. In addition, analog 2 showed strong scavenging activity against DPPH and ABTS radicals. Furthermore, analog 2 not only reduced ROS levels, which induce melanogenesis, but it also suppressed tyrosinase and MITF (microphthalamia-associated transcription factor) protein levels and the expressions of melanogenesis-related genes. These results suggest that analog 2 is an efficient tyrosinase inhibitor that alleviates melanogenesis by dual mechanisms of (i) the inhibition of melanogenesis-related proteins and genes and (ii) the direct inhibition of tyrosinase activity.
abstract_zh: 酪氨酸酶的决定速率作用使其成为黑色素生成机制中的关键组成部分。基于两种强效酪氨酸酶抑制剂的结构特征，即(Z)-5-(3-羟基-4-甲氧基亚苄基)-2-硫代噻唑烷-4-酮（5-HMT）和(Z)-2-(2,4-二羟基亚苄基)苯并[4,5]咪唑并[2,1-b]噻唑-3(2H)-酮（化合物I），设计了十三种(Z)-5-(取代亚苄基)-3-苯基-2-硫代噻唑烷-4-酮（(Z)-BPTT）类似物。通过Knoevenagel缩合生成的(Z)-BPTT类似物的三取代双键几何构型，利用(13)C NMR谱中的邻位(1)H和(13)C耦合常数确定。四种类似物（编号1-3和6）对蘑菇酪氨酸酶的抑制效力比曲酸强9至29倍。动力学研究结果表明，这四种类似物竞争性抑制蘑菇酪氨酸酶，并通过对接模拟得到支持。此外，使用人酪氨酸酶的对接结果表明，类似物2和3可能成为强效的人酪氨酸酶抑制剂。使用B16F10细胞（一种黑色素瘤细胞系）的体外研究表明，类似物1、2、3和6对细胞酪氨酸酶和黑色素生成的抑制作用均强于曲酸，且无明显细胞毒性。特别是，具有儿茶酚基团的类似物2表现出极强的抗黑色素生成效应。此外，类似物2对DPPH和ABTS自由基显示出强清除活性。进一步地，类似物2不仅降低了诱导黑色素生成的ROS水平，还抑制了酪氨酸酶和MITF（小眼畸形相关转录因子）蛋白水平以及黑色素生成相关基因的表达。这些结果表明，类似物2是一种高效的酪氨酸酶抑制剂，通过双重机制缓解黑色素生成：（i）抑制黑色素生成相关蛋白和基因，以及（ii）直接抑制酪氨酸酶活性。
